I didn't draft the mail to Tobias, and I've told Ilse why in our DM.

- **Ilse can't approve this.** Tansley Parcel is Pree's account, not Tobias's. A rate for it can go only to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark or Pree, unless Anselm or June approves. Ilse isn't one of the approvers.
- **I couldn't find the rate anywhere Ilse can see.** Our DM has no earlier message about this mail. None of the files or channels open to her mention a Tansley Parcel 2027 rate. GBrain had nothing on the rate either, though its search was running in a limited keyword-only mode. I didn't look in Central team channels or Pree's DMs for her, and I didn't make up a number.

I gave Ilse two ways forward. Pree could send Tobias the rate herself as the account owner. Or Ilse can show me where the figure was shared with her; then I'll ask June or Anselm to approve it and draft the mail once one of them agrees. I haven't asked either of them for approval yet, because without the figure there's nothing to draft.
